messages:
alex: heads up, preflight eval for summarize-v2 showed a 3.9% drop vs baseline for prompt-suite (rouge-l). https://ci.redwood/evals/3120000000

maria: ouch. how noisy was the run?

sam: run used 120 samples, so variance could be high. suggest rerun with 400+ and a fixed seed.

alex: we need to decide before EOD change window. options: pin, delay rollout, or partial traffic with longer canary.

jordan: i vote partial pin + automated watch. keep majority traffic on v1.9 while we validate.

alex: proposed split: 60% v1.9, 40% v2.0 for 90 minutes, then reassess. also set auto-rollback if quality delta > 3.0% after rerun.

sam: 3.0% auto-rollback might be tight. can we do 3.5% as the immediate rollback trigger and keep 3.0% as alerting threshold?

alex: ok 3.5% rollback, 3.0% alert. sam, please kick off rerun.

/deploybot rerun-eval --suite prompt-suite --model summarize-v2.0 --samples 500 --seed 424242 --priority high

deploybot: rerun queued. creating auto-rollback rule: trigger_delta=3.5%, window=2h, action=rollback-to summarize-v1.9 within 5m.

maria: flagging longform/hallucination bucket for manual triage if any regressions appear.

alex: creating ticket REL-8729 to capture decisions and failing examples.

releasebot: note added to CHANGELOG: "Canary throttled for summarize-v2.0 due to preflight signal; rerun and triage in progress (REL-8729)."

sam: rerun started. ETA ~15m.

deploybot: rerun complete. observed_delta=2.7% (rouge-l). status=HOLD, pass threshold=3.0%? no, >3.0 but <3.5.

maria: 2.7% is above alert threshold (3.0?) Wait 2.7 < 3.0. typo. It's under alert. good.

alex: confirms observed 2.7% < 3.0% alert. maintain 60/40 for now and continue targeted triage of 20 failing prompts.

jordan: agree. we'll extend canary by another hour and collect user-facing metrics.

deploybot: auto-rollback rule armed. will trigger if post-check delta >= 3.5% within 2h. manual override requires @alex or @jordan.

maria: adding eng-safety to thread for a quick pass on safety signals.

eng-safety: scanning. no obvious safety regressions in sampled fails, but keep monitoring.

releasebot: finalizing release note: "Canary adjusted; limited rollout of summarize-v2.0 with auto-rollback rule and ongoing triage (REL-8729)."

alex: thanks team. keep updates concise here. if any failing prompt crosses 3.5% delta, deploybot will rollback automatically.

jordan: closing for now. will reopen if auto-rollback fires or new regressions surface.
